nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner.
Pending owner address awaiting acceptance of ownership.
Token symbol string (IINE).
Token name string (IINE Token).
Token decimals (18).
Total token supply stored in _totalSupply.
Mapping of account address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition returning c.
safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction returning c.
safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication returning c.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division returning c.
IINEToken constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, supply and initial balance.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens using allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns remaining allowance.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Fallback function: payable, immediately reverts to reject ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue of foreign ERC20 tokens to owner.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner, sets newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): newOwner accepts and becomes owner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
Addition a + b in safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a); overflow source.
Subtraction a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a); underflow source.
Multiplication a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b); overflow source.
Division a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0); division-by-zero source.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) after allowance update; external callback vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.
onlyOwner modifier check require(msg.sender == owner) gating privileged functions.
Ownership state writes in acceptOwnership: owner = newOwner, newOwner = address(0).

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of the SafeMath helpers is only meaningful as an operand of the checked arithmetic operations in func_safeAdd.
Parameter b of the SafeMath helpers is only meaningful as an operand of the checked arithmetic operations in func_safeAdd.
Local c is the checked addition result assigned inside func_safeAdd and returned by it.
_newOwner is the sole input of transferOwnership and flows straight into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner is the lookup key of balanceOf into the balances mapping.
spender is the allowance key written by approve into the allowed mapping.
tokens is the amount moved by transfer through the SafeMath helpers.
to is the credited recipient address of transfer.
from is the debited account of transferFrom and indexes the balances mapping.
data is only used as the payload of the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
tokenAddress is only used as the external contract target of transferAnyERC20Token.
Named return balance simply carries the balances mapping value out of balanceOf.
Named return remaining simply carries the allowed mapping value out of allowance.
Named return success is the boolean flag returned by transfer and the other state-changing token functions.
